svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Pantheon Research high-level architecture: seven layers from external data sources through a governed data platform, deterministic research engines, a deterministic plus five-model AI layer with Gemini as the hackathon integration, the information layer, the signal and agent layer, and a staged execution boundary. AI research flows to human review and a human decision; there is no path from a model output to an order.
svg.text: Governed AI-native cross-asset investment research OS · seven layers · human remains the portfolio manager
Macro & rates · Equities (US / CN / HK / SG) · Crypto & on-chain · DeFi protocols
Filings & fundamentals · Social / alternative data · Positioning · Market structure
Raw provider data is never passed straight to a model.
TTL / freshness · data-quality labels · fail-closed on stale or missing
Missing or stale data is labelled — never silently guessed. Evidence packs are SHA-256 content-hashed.
Reproducible scores, regimes and signal candidates are computed before any model interprets them.
Five-Model Research Layer — disagreement is surfaced, not averaged
the pre-existing four-provider lane Gemini joined.
Lane A — Evidence-backed (graded by source tier)
Web dashboard · PWA / mobile · application APIs · module-maturity registry
HUMAN REVIEW GATE — mandatory before any decision
Advice is permitted (views, ratings, direction, risk/reward). Execution instructions and position sizing are refused in code.
NO LIVE AUTONOMOUS TRADING · no order path from any model output
Pantheon holds no broker credential and no signing key. Layer 7 is not reachable from Layer 4.
The governing path — AI decides what the research says; a human decides what the portfolio does

Providers → Canonical Observations → Product Snapshots & Evidence Packs → Deterministic Engines → Gemini / Multi-Model Research → Signals & Human Review → Human Decision → Independently Gated Execution
Not claimed: autonomous trading · model-generated alpha · proven investment performance · AI override of deterministic ratings · movement of user capital.
Pantheon Research · pantheon-research.com · Build with Gemini XPRIZE 2026 · Snapshot 2026-08-14
